headline: Your reason for rising shapes everything that follows
universal_truth: The 'why' behind your actions determines their meaning
fun_facts: The Japanese concept of 'ikigai'—reason for being—has been linked to longevity in Okinawa, the island with the world's longest-lived people
People with a clear sense of purpose have 15% lower mortality risk, according to a study of 7,000 adults
Viktor Frankl, Holocaust survivor and psychiatrist, observed that those with a reason to live were most likely to survive
discussion_questions: What gets you out of bed on difficult mornings?
Has your 'why' changed over different seasons of life?
How might a clearer purpose change your daily experience?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Every morning, something pulls you from sleep. For some, it's obligation. For others, it's excitement. But the deepest motivation comes from purpose. Today we explore why your reason for rising matters more than you think.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Nietzsche wrote: 'He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.' But here's the question most people never ask themselves directly. What is your why?
cliff.prompt: Where does a sense of purpose come from?

options.response: Many people wait to discover it. But there's another path that's often more powerful...
Yes. Purpose isn't hidden treasure—it's something you actively construct through choices and commitments.

q1.title: The Ikigai Secret
q1.script: In Okinawa, Japan, there's no word for retirement—because the concept of ikigai means you always have a reason to get up. This intersection of what you love, what you're good at, what the world needs, and what you can be paid for creates lasting motivation.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "The Ikigai Secret"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Purpose and Longevity
q2.script: Research consistently links purpose to physical health. People with a strong sense of why live longer, have lower rates of heart disease, and recover faster from setbacks. Purpose isn't just philosophy—it's medicine for the body and mind.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: The Constructed Why
q3.script: Here's liberating news: your why doesn't have to be grand. It can be as simple as being present for your family, mastering a craft, or making one person smile each day. Purpose is less about scale and more about commitment. Small whys can sustain big lives.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You don't need to have it all figured out. You just need something worth getting up for tomorrow. Start there. Your purpose will grow as you tend to it.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's today's lesson on the power of purpose. Tomorrow, we'll explore what makes life matter. Until then, consider: what's your reason for tomorrow morning?
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Purpose Clarity - The Why Question
growTrack.learning_objective: Articulate a simple, personal reason for getting up each day
growTrack.activity: Write one sentence that completes this: 'Tomorrow, I'm getting up because...' Make it specific and personal. Post it where you'll see it in the morning.
